events_seen: CUT (Oct 25 (today)): Jake released Cedric Tillman (WR, NO).
TRADE (Oct 24 (yesterday)): Charles receives Jadarian Price (RB, SEA). Jake receives Kirk Cousins (QB, LV).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (2 days ago)): Jake added Darnell Mooney (WR, NYG).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (2 days ago)): Jake added Tommy Tremble (TE, CAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 23 (2 days ago)): Wingard added Josh Cuevas (TE, BAL).
CUT (Oct 22 (3 days ago)): Kevin released Calvin Ridley (WR, TEN).
CUT (Oct 21 (4 days ago)): Kevin released Darius Slayton (WR, FA).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 21 (4 days ago)): Charles added Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI) (dropped Chris Brooks (RB, GB)).

WEEK 6 RESULTS: Fronge def. Corbishley, 103.8-88.3; Charles def. Adam, 136.8-112.3; Brent def. Drew, 132.3-57.5 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Shaq, 113.8-101.9; Kevin def. Wingard, 114.3-59.7 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Ryan, 149.1-122.1

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Shaq leads Corbishley 94.4-59.6 in the afternoon window and the story writes itself — Monarch Wideout Bank, the team that made zero trades in 2025, is currently on pace to hand Apex Iron Capital its third loss and knock the number-two seed's playoff cushion down to a game over Kevin. The QB depth problem is no longer theoretical.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Fronge is down 47.7 to Ryan at the half and I have been asking for a dedicated segment on the Havana relocation decision since week three — FORG at $86.62, zero pick liquidity, and now the defending champion is using your franchise as a practice rep on a Sunday afternoon.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Mitchum to have a rough week and Brent is up 59.0-40.2 live, which is not a coincidence — Deepwater put up 149 last week and the market at $94.32 thought that was sustainable, but Obsidian's TE monopoly shows up every single time the schedule allows it to breathe.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, the Charles-Wingard game is 53.3-36.6 and I locked Crownline, and my season record is now sitting exactly where it needs to be — the cleanest ticket on the slate remains the cleanest ticket on the slate, and Wingard's 567 points for the year is not going to surprise anyone by Thursday.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Kevin leads Jake 61.9-45.5 right now and that is the single most interesting live game on the board — Jake just sent Kirk Cousins to LV yesterday and is running the EchoPoint desk down a quarterback while Kevin, who cut two veterans in four days, is somehow winning.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I took Corbishley and Shaq is at 94.4. My season record is 5-7. I am aware of both facts simultaneously and I am not going to pretend they are unrelated.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS 0-12 AND HAS 547 POINTS FOR AND IS LOSING TO ADAM BY TWENTY-FIVE. ATLAS AT $35.28 IS THE CHEAPEST LISTING IN EXCHANGE HISTORY AND THE SCOREBOARD IS DOING ITS BEST TO EXPLAIN WHY. THE VOID MATCH HAS A WINNER AND IT IS NOT DREW.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Jake cuts Cedric Tillman today, added Mooney and Tremble two days ago, traded away Cousins yesterday, and is currently losing to Kevin live — EchoPoint's TE desk is still empty after all of it, and the Ledger is going to have a full accounting of what that vacancy has cost this roster by week's end.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: People keep asking me where I had Mitchum in the power rankings and I would love to tell them but the rankings are unavailable this run — what I can tell you is that Deepwater at $94.32 after a +7.6% surge and a 149-point week being outscored by Obsidian right now is exactly the kind of regression the model flags every time a team wins by 27 on a fluky scoring week.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Kevin releasing Ridley, releasing Slayton, winning live against Jake — I don't care how the sausage is made at Redline Distressed Capital, the man is 9-3 and sitting in third place and the roster philosophy everyone called a cleanup disaster is currently threatening a top-two seed.
